SELECT n.NOTICE_ID, n.TITLE, n.CONTENT, n.AUTHOR_EMP_ID, e.EMP_NAME as AUTHOR_NAME, n.VIEWS, n.CREATED_AT, n.UPDATED_AT, n.IS_DELETED FROM NOTICE n LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON n.AUTHOR_EMP_ID = e.EMP_ID WHERE n.IS_DELETED = 'N'
AND ( UPPER(n.TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(n.CONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
AND n.CREATED_AT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND n.CREATED_AT <= TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
ORDER BY n.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTICE n WHERE n.IS_DELETED = 'N'
AND ( UPPER(n.TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(n.CONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
AND n.CREATED_AT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND n.CREATED_AT <= TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')

SELECT n.NOTICE_ID, n.TITLE, n.CONTENT, n.AUTHOR_EMP_ID, e.EMP_NAME as AUTHOR_NAME, n.VIEWS, n.CREATED_AT, n.UPDATED_AT, n.IS_DELETED FROM NOTICE n LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON n.AUTHOR_EMP_ID = e.EMP_ID WHERE n.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND n.IS_DELETED = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE ( TITLE, CONTENT, AUTHOR_EMP_ID, VIEWS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, IS_DELETED ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{authorEmpId}, 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
UPDATE NOTICE SET IS_DELETED = 'Y', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
UPDATE NOTICE SET VIEWS = VIEWS + 1 WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT n.NOTICE_ID, n.TITLE, n.CONTENT, n.AUTHOR_EMP_ID, e.EMP_NAME as AUTHOR_NAME, n.VIEWS, n.CREATED_AT, n.UPDATED_AT, n.IS_DELETED FROM NOTICE n LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON n.AUTHOR_EMP_ID = e.EMP_ID WHERE n.IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY n.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
